description: What a city index's websites say, compared with every index of the same kind: the share of listed businesses with no web address, only a social profile or their own site; the share of sites that turn an AI crawler away, publish a readable menu, take bookings or orders directly or grade A or B; the share that declare an English version, show prices, link to WhatsApp, show an old copyright year or load a consent manager; the middle visible price and the page weight. Each with its base, rank and medians. Page: https://directindex.org/city/{slug}#sites and https://directindex.org/stats.
